RelationSuggestion.description: How an existing similar item relates to the candidate, assessed during triage independently of the novel-or-duplicate decision.

SimilarItemClassification.description: An independent assessment of one existing item's relationship to the candidate.

justification.description: Why this relationship holds, grounded in the content of both items.

anyOf.description: The candidate records knowledge not already captured by an existing item.
The candidate restates an existing item, adding no meaningful new information. A candidate that contradicts an existing item is never a duplicate.

TriageDecision.description: Whether the candidate records new knowledge or duplicates an existing item.

TriageItemReference.description: A reference to one of the provided similar items by its context index.

description: The triage classification for a single candidate. Contains the novel/duplicate decision and independent per-item relationship assessments.

similar_item_decisions.description: One assessment per provided similar item, each made independently of the novel/duplicate outcome.

title: TriageClassification
